fields.v: Spec-first (extractor's classification: a Spec Kit-template specification is written before the code and given to the agent as the task prompt, then not maintained); authors' wording: 'task specification', 'structure derived from the GitHub Spec Kit template'
fields.quote: Each spec variation is constructed from the task’s original SWE-bench problem statement, with structure derived from the GitHub Spec Kit template [9].
fields.why: A Spec Kit-structured spec written up front and used once as the agent's task input matches the spec-first level, even though the paper does not name a level itself.
fields.doubt: O nível SDD é classificação tua, não dos autores. Uma especificação no formato Spec Kit, escrita antes e dada ao agente como tarefa, encaixa em spec-first. Lê a pág. 3 (§3.1) e decide entre 'Spec-first' e 'Não classificável'.
